claims.assertion: Yazhi says Alpha Draconis created the Orion Council, which coordinated a Reptilian invasion of Vega, Avalon, and Lyra; peaceful Lyrians fled and spread across the galaxy.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: She says the Federation formed about 900,000 Earth years ago as a mutual-defense alliance after Reptilian attacks pushed many species toward extinction.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: This is an approximate Earth chronology.

claims.assertion: About 40,000 years ago, Yazhi says Lyrians settled an unusual 13-planet solar system that already hosted developing civilizations, including Earth; they coexisted peacefully.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
